purpose: Candidate enumeration only. Complete means the requested source stream/window was exhausted, not that every model release was found.

streams.reason: Entire public Epoch AI CSV parsed; language leads filtered by publication/update window. This curated dataset is not an exhaustive release census.

issues.reason: Model field is blank; retained under its reference title when available.

gaps: A successful API response covers only that source, not all releases. Deleted/private entries, incorrect tags and unannounced models can be missed.
Historical repository updates are not historical release dates; combine inventory/history with dated primary announcements.
Manual sentinels, credential requirements, failures and incomplete pagination require follow-up.
